full_judgment: 8. Mr. Mahmudul Islam, the learned Advocate for the respondent, on the other hand, submitted that on refusal by the appellant to accept the rent sent through money order for the months of December 1990 and January 1991 on 13.1.1991 the respondents were not defaulters because of regular disposit of rents of rents in the Court of Rent Controller with his permission. He further submits that the learned Single Judge did not commit any wrong to send the suit on remand for determining default on fresh evidence and that without framing any issue in respect of bonafide requirement the learned admission S.C.C Judge wrongly found that the shop rooms required for bonafide purpose by the appellant although the appellant had other shop rooms in the suit holding which he let out after institution of the suit. Mr. Mahmudul Islam further submits that the respondent being a bonafide purchaser of possession of the Shop rooms the learned Advocate son of the same and the landlord is estopped from taking khas posses learned S.C.C. Judge erred in not considering this aspect.
